datasets.title: HDX HAPI Data for India
datasets.description: This dataset contains data obtained from the HDX Humanitarian API (HDX HAPI), which provides standardized humanitarian indicators designed for seamless interoperability from multiple sources. The data facilitates automated workflows and visualizations to support humanitarian decision making. For more information, please see the HDX HAPI landing page and documentation .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hdx-hapi-ind]
datasets.details: HDX HAPI is refreshed daily, but the source datasets may have different update schedules. Please refer to the source datasets for each subcategory to verify their specific update frequency.

entity.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)

lineage.description: HDX HAPI aggregates standardized humanitarian indicators from multiple authoritative sources (INFORM, ACLED, UNHCR, WFP, OPHI) into a unified API for India. The dataset integrates national risk assessments derived from hazard exposure and vulnerability models, conflict event records with casualty data, refugee population statistics, and food security/poverty indicators to support humanitarian decision-making workflows.

sources.name: INFORM
sources.description: Provides national risk assessment framework integrating hazard exposure, vulnerability, and coping capacity indicators for disaster risk classification

sources.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)
sources.description: Provides conflict event records with fatality counts and spatial location data for impact assessment

sources.name: UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency
sources.description: Provides refugee and person of concern population statistics disaggregated by origin, asylum location, gender, and age

sources.name: WFP - World Food Programme
sources.description: Provides food price and market monitoring data for food security impact assessment

sources.name: Oxford Poverty & Human Development Initiative
sources.description: Provides poverty rate indicators for socioeconomic impact assessment
